articles.title: Reality Check: Your AI Strategy is Only as Good as Your Infrastructure
articles.excerpt: Every second post on my feed right now is a non-stop stream of AI, LLMs, autonomous agents, Claude, Gemini—the list goes on. It’s the shiny new toy, the board-level priority, and the "future of the business."

articles.title: Monoliths Disguised as Micro-Services
articles.excerpt: These days, I've been thinking about distributed monolith systems disguised as microservices (the "silver bullet" solution from nowadays).

articles.title: Microservices Architecture: Introduction
articles.excerpt: Microservices architecture, or simply microservices, has become very popular in the last few years. I will be writing about microservices on the next articles, and for start I'd like to introduce the concept and present it's main characteristics.

articles.title: Upgrading Neo4J: v2 to v3
articles.excerpt: A few days ago I had to upgrade a Neo4j environment from v2.2.3 to v3.1.1, and as I haven't found any solid material on the internet about version migration, I tought it would be useful to publish this short tutorial in order to help others who might find some trouble while upgrading the datastore.

articles.title: Host your static website on Github for free
articles.excerpt: Github( https://github.com ) is a great social coding platform, based on git-scm, with a clean and fluid interface and a lot of useful features for those who need a cloud based source versioning.
